title: Scrambled Eggs with Onion and Cheddar
blurb: Soft scrambled eggs with sweet caramelised onion and melted cheddar.
steps: Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and add the chopped onion.
Cook the onion for 6 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and golden.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat them lightly with a fork.
Pour the eggs into the pan with the onion and let them sit for a few seconds.
Gently stir and fold the eggs with a spatula, cooking until they form soft curds but are still slightly wet.
Remove the pan from the heat, scatter over the cheddar and fold through gently so it melts into the eggs.
